reference_role: Original catalog sprites inspected as style and scale references, not copied as mod artwork

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: HD sprite for equipment shop/inventory in 1990s military science-fiction vertical shooter. Input image is an ORIGINAL STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Generate a distinct Seeker Swarm launcher: compact gray armored missile pod with three narrow rocket tips pointing exactly UP, dark launch channels, restrained amber indicator dots and red service tab. Top-down orthographic overhead view, symmetrical compact military silhouette. Isolated single object centered on genuinely transparent 1024x1024 square canvas, silhouette central 70%, at least 12% transparent margin. Reference style: chunky readable silhouette, muted gunmetal, upper-left highlights, limited palette. Restrained machined detail appropriate HD. No text, labels, glow, shadows outside body, border, frame, extra objects. Display logical 16x16 SD and64x64 HD; make silhouette readable after reduction.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated homing missile projectile sprite for a military science-fiction vertical shooter. Reference image is original STYLE reference for chunky readability ONLY. Generate a small slender naval gray missile pointing EXACTLY UP, white metal pointed nose, gray body with a narrow red band, two small fins, short amber engine exhaust directly below. Top-down orthographic overhead view, centered symmetric military silhouette. Genuine transparent square canvas with large margins; missile silhouette width:height1:2 and occupies central70%height. Palette gray slate white amber red, strongest light upper-left, crisp readable pixel-inspired HD detail. No spacecraft, no launcher, no multiplemissiles, no expansiveglow, no shadow, no text/labels/border. Logicalcanvas8x16 and32x64HD.

conversion: prepare_art.rs crops to alpha>=128 silhouette, fits with transparent margins, preserves aspect and reduces to logical SD/4xHD. SD nearest sampling alpha128; HD Lanczos3 alpha64. Pixel values quantized at runtime.
